title: QUIC and Covert: Novel HTTP/3-Powered RATs Target Southeast Asian Governments
content_md: We uncover a Southeast Asian cyberespionage campaign deploying PerfectPioneer RAT, modular KUKURAT and stealth HTTP/3 C2 communication channels. The post QUIC and Covert: Novel HTTP/3-Powered RATs Target Southeast Asian Governments appeared first on Unit 42 .
